inputs.title: Delete locks
inputs.content_preview:
> **ℹ️ Info**
>
> This articles explains how to “delete locks” in MongoDB

As part of a [Server Host Recovery](https://help.alteryx.com/current/server/server-host-recovery-guide) or [Reindex](https://alteryx.atlassian.net/wiki/search?text=Reindex+MongoDB) you need to "delete locks".

You'll delete all records from the **AlteryxGallery.locks** and **AlteryxGallery_Lucene.luceneFs.locks** collections.  These locks contain the machine name of the machine that wrote them and can't be deleted by anot
